headline: 电影剧集双热：爱情假说与龙族领跑
summary: 本周电影市场由《爱情假说》《野兽之心》等领跑；剧集方面《菜鸟老警》《龙族》持续热播，待播《女巫团学院》《幻视任务》蓄势。

industryHighlights.text: 电影《爱情假说》《野兽之心》领跑本周热作榜。
industryHighlights.en: The Love Hypothesis and Beast Heart lead this week's film buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 剧集《菜鸟老警》《龙族》持续热播。
industryHighlights.en: The Rookie and House of the Dragon remain hot on TV.

industryHighlights.text: 待播剧《女巫团学院》《幻视任务》蓄势待发。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming series Witch Academy and Vision Quest build anticipation.

industryHighlights.text: 待映电影《复仇者联盟5》《猫鼬》等受期待。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films Avengers 5 and Mongoose are highly anticipated.

headlineEn: Film & TV Heat: Love Hypothesis and Dragon Lead
summaryEn: This week's film scene is led by The Love Hypothesis and Beast Heart, while TV hits The Rookie and House of the Dragon stay hot; upcoming Witch Academy and Vision Quest build buzz.
